name: yo-skills-bundle

validation.research: primary sources recorded in each skill's references

notes: The bundle is self-contained: no non-Yo skill is required by a Yo workflow.
The Golden Engineering Standard requires the smallest complete production-quality solution, evidence for every added moving part, root-cause defect closure, and a final simplification pass.
Dated archives preserve the 19 skill trees that existed before the 2026-07-10 rewrite.
Install all 20 skills for either host; platform-specific skills trigger only in their applicable context.
Clear low-risk work bypasses routing; observed RED proof is risk-based rather than mandatory for every regression test.
One risk lane and evidence record continue across handoffs; scoped work uses inline impact and the smallest affected required gate.
Only the current request, accepted clarifications, explicitly resumed work, and required proof authorize work; ambient findings do not become backlog or follow-up tasks.
Repository-specific GitHub writing conventions live in skills/yo-gh-write/references/repo-profiles.md.
